scope: Synthetic SQLite/OPF/EPUB and proposal conversion probes; no source application or Kisaki runtime execution.

five independent source book rows are readable
read-only handle rejects mutations
extension loading cannot be enabled
stored 7 means 3.5 stars and maps to 70
stored zero is explicit unrated
no rating link in a complete library means unrated
missing optional OPF rating remains unknown
invalid fractional stored rating is rejected
negative stored rating is rejected
comments remain bibliographic description
edition duplicate shares ISBN but not source row id
conflicting edition evaluations are not merged by row order
boolean false is retained separately from absence
multi-valued custom columns use their link table
a comma in a stored label is not a separator
computed column templates are not executed
dynamic table ids cannot inject SQL
date field uses selected source display timezone
legitimate first day is preserved
calibre undefined date means no date
malformed date is rejected
impossible calendar date is rejected instead of normalized
explicit work count creates one dated and one undated fact
part completion never becomes a work count
zero count and a completion date conflict
no selected completion facts create no history
reader scope excludes the other user
removed annotations are not resurrected
four live selected annotation rows remain
latest position is selected within one user and format
position percent does not create a completion fact
data rows resolve one present and two missing formats
EPUB and PDF are separate format files
source paths cannot escape the library
absolute source paths are not treated as library members
EPUB container has four actual members
EPUB mimetype is correct
highlight names the exact EPUB member
source endpoints extract the actual synthetic quote
source document path converts to standard package CFI
end offset remains end-exclusive
standard CFI resolves to the same text endpoint
out-of-range endpoint is rejected
surrogate pair cannot be split
calibre viewport geometry is not a source text point
missing spine item does not fall back to the first chapter
MOBI quote and comment remain available for a Note

backup OPF carries five scoped annotation envelopes
save-to-disk OPF does not invent database annotation fields

note image bytes have PNG signature

every synthetic input byte remains unchanged after reads

limitations: The SQLite fixture contains selected ordinary source tables, not calibre FTS tables or triggers.
CFI checks cover this simple, unchanged XHTML tree only; full normalization, range forms and real viewer round trips remain implementation acceptance.
No real user export, WAL recovery, host writes, attachments preparation or extension UI was exercised.
